input_snapshot.goal: An autonomous trading research factory that continuously converts raw ideas into scored evidence across crypto, forex, and prediction markets.

plan.title: EMA Trend Gate ETH with asset-specific optimization
plan.objective: Run EMA Trend Gate strategy on ETHUSDT with expanded parameter optimization to improve upon prior 0.489 OOS Sharpe result
plan.hypothesis: ETH-specific parameter optimization (wider rsi_oversold/rsi_overbought ranges, expanded hold_bars grid) will improve OOS Sharpe from 0.489 toward 0.7+ by better adapting to ETH's distinct volatility characteristics compared to BTC
plan.strategy_rationale: This addresses the prior failure where execution pointed to non-existent strategies/ema_trend_gate_eth/wfa_config.yaml. The directory now exists with ETH-specific expanded parameter ranges. Using the same multi-timeframe EMA Trend Gate logic that achieved 0.998 on BTC and 0.489 on ETH, but with ETH-adapted optimization grid to close the cross-asset gap.

historical_depth_requirement.justification: ETH has deep liquid history since 2017 on Binance. Using 3+ years matches prior BTC/ETH WFA windows for valid comparison.

source_plan.selection_reason: Existing deep ETH dataset (binance_ethusdt_1h_deep.csv) already present in workspace/data/

plan.scope_selection_rationale: ETHUSDT is the natural follow-up to prior ETH run. Using existing deep data ensures clean comparison. The 1h with 4h regime filter timeframe is proven effective from prior BTC (0.998 Sharpe) and ETH (0.489 Sharpe) runs.

data_acquisition.reason: binance_ethusdt_1h_deep.csv exists with multi-year history (~64k bars, 2018-2026)

inputs: Prior ETH unoptimized run: 0.489 Sharpe, -14.34% DD, 1238 trades
implementation_steps: 1. Verify ema_trend_gate_eth directory and wfa_config.yaml exist (DONE)
2. Verify ETH deep data has sufficient history (3+ years)
3. Execute full WFA with Optuna optimization on ETHUSDT
4. Compare optimized ETH metrics vs prior unoptimized ETH run
5. Document improvement or confirm asset-specific limitation

evaluation_criteria.status_gate: Full WFA completed with at least 60 windows and 500+ total trades

fallback_if_blocked: If WFA fails due to data issues, fall back to using standard ETH data and re-run
If optimization fails to improve ETH, document the persistent gap as evidence for asset-specific strategy requirements
notes: This experiment directly follows up RUN-20260404075959-ij3gm9 which failed due to non-existent config path
Directory strategies/ema_trend_gate_eth/ now exists with wfa_config.yaml
Success criteria: ETH optimized Sharpe >= 0.7 (improvement from 0.489)
If ETH cannot reach 0.7, this confirms structural difference between ETH and BTC behavior

relevant_execution_lessons.lesson: BNB is the worst-performing asset in EMA Trend Gate series
relevant_execution_lessons.specific_finding: BNB achieved 0.432 OOS Sharpe vs SOL 1.373 (+218%), BTC 0.998 (+131%), ETH 0.489 (+13%). Exchange token utility-driven demand creates distinct volatility regime that reduces strategy effectiveness.

relevant_execution_lessons.lesson: Cross-asset generalization gap confirmed: ETH underperforms BTC with same strategy using BTC-pinned parameters
relevant_execution_lessons.specific_finding: Prior ETH run (RUN-20260403123500-01) achieved 0.489 OOS Sharpe vs BTC 0.998 using ema_trend_gate with pinned ema4h_period=50, ema1h_period=20, rsi_period=14

known_blocker_patterns.lesson: Planner must verify strategy directories exist before referencing them in execution commands
